name: Calm Before the Storm
summary: After the queen's fall, Alchemist Pestlezugg sends his latest findings to those who may act. You carry his report on Un'Goro to Zilzibin Drumlore in Orgrimmar.

sections.title: A Report for Orgrimmar
sections.body: Gadgetzan cannot manage alone, so Alchemist Pestlezugg sends you with his latest findings on Un'Goro. He wants them in the hands of those who can act. Pestlezugg expects Zilzibin Drumlore to be in the upper part of the Drag in Orgrimmar. Zilzibin has friends high in the Horde, and drawing them in may offer a way through this alive.

sections.title: Zilzibin's Answer
sections.body: Zilzibin Drumlore calls those who see only their hatred of the Alliance fools. He says he cannot prove the silithid threat any further without dropping them into a hive. He welcomes the report, but doubts it will help. The Horde ignores every threat but the Alliance. Thrall himself might act if the facts reached him, though conflicting advice presses on him from every side. Zilzibin urges you to stay committed to defeating the silithid.

faq.q: Who sends you with the report?
aliases: quest giver calm before the storm
who gives calm before the storm
faq.answer: Alchemist Pestlezugg sends you from Gadgetzan.
Zilzibin Drumlore is in Orgrimmar. Pestlezugg expects him in the upper part of the Drag.

faq.q: Why does Pestlezugg send the report to Zilzibin Drumlore?
faq.answer: Gadgetzan cannot manage this alone. Zilzibin has friends high in the Horde, and drawing them in may offer a way through this alive.

aliases: previous quest calm before the storm
faq.answer: Pawn Captures Queen comes directly before this. You were sent after the Gorishi Hive Queen.
